descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Consultanță și servicii de afaceri și Dezvoltare de software
Where you’ll make a difference 
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment.
Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) to create consistent, scalable environments.
Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and release teams to improve delivery workflows.
Monitor pipeline performance, deployments, and environment stability; investigate and resolve issues.
Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting to support system availability and performance.
Improve delivery speed, consistency, and quality through automation and tooling.
Integrate security, access-control, and compliance requirements into pipelines and environments.
Document processes, configurations, and standards to support team consistency and knowledge sharing.
 Skills for success 
Experience as a DevOps Engineer, Build Engineer, Platform Engineer, or in a similar software engineering role.
Experience with CI/CD tools and pipeline automation.
Knowledge of and experience with Salesforce.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and configuration-management tools.
Experience with cloud platforms and modern development environments.
Familiarity with source-control systems and branching strategies.
Experience troubleshooting across development, test, staging, and production environments.
Knowledge of scripting, automation, deployment practices, and system monitoring.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
Attention to detail and a commitment to operational quality.
